caption_L1: Stadiums of the clubs of German soccer Bundesliga by capacity 2020/21 season is a bar plot. A categorical scale with Allianz Arena (FC Bayern Munich) on one end and Wohninvest Weserstadion (SV Werder Bremen) at the other can be seen on the x-axis, labeled association football venue. A linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 80,000 can be found along the y-axis, marked Capacity.
caption_L2L3: Signal Iduna Park has the highest capacity of all venues. Exactly half of the venues have capacity under 40,000. Five venues have capacity over 60,000. All venues have capacity over 20,000. Signal Iduna Park has almost four times the capacity of An der Alten Försterei.
